map.和 NX 关系？: What is the relationship to NX?
map.教学演示：演示净出口 NX 是 GDP 支出法的一项。: Teaching demo: shows that net exports NX is one component of the expenditure approach to GDP.
map.由出口与进口求贸易差额 使用指南: Trade balance from exports and imports user guide
map.货物贸易差额不含服务；全口径看经常账户，本工具按录入的进出口口径。结果仅作经济学: The goods trade balance excludes services; the full measure is the current account, and this tool follows the imports and exports you enter. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only and are not investment advice or a policy basis; for forecasts and empirical estimates defer to authoritative statistics and textbooks.
map.贸易差额即净出口 NX=X−M，是 GDP=C+I+G+NX 的组成部分。结果仅: The trade balance is net exports NX = X - M, a component of GDP = C + I + G + NX. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only and are not investment advice or a policy basis; for forecasts and empirical estimates defer to authoritative statistics and textbooks.
map.贸易差额计算器，输入出口 X 与进口 M 按 BoT=X−M 求贸易顺差或逆差，: Trade balance calculator: enter exports X and imports M to get the surplus or deficit as BoT = X - M, for balance of payments analysis.
map.趋势观察：对多期录入，看贸易差额走向。: Trend view: enter several periods to see where the trade balance is heading.
map.输入出口 X 与进口 M，求贸易差额。: Enter exports X and imports M to get the trade balance.
map.顺差代表对外净输出，但长期过大可能伴储蓄过剩或汇率压力，需结合结构看。结果仅作经: A surplus means net exports to the rest of the world, but an excessively large one can accompany excess savings or exchange rate pressure, so it must be read in structural context. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only and are not investment advice or a policy basis; for forecasts and empirical estimates defer to authoritative statistics and textbooks.
map.顺差逆差：录入进出口，算差额，正为顺差、负为逆差。: Surplus or deficit: enter exports and imports and the difference is positive for a surplus and negative for a deficit.
map.：示例：出口 2000 亿、进口 1800 亿，贸易差额=+200 亿（顺差）。: : example: exports of 200 billion against imports of 180 billion give a trade balance of +20 billion, a surplus.
